description: Na₂Zn₂Se₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six ZnSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with five NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with six ZnSe₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.98-3.10 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with eight ZnSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with four ZnSe₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.96-3.08 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.84-3.29 Å. There are two inequivalent Zn sites. In the first Zn site, Zn is bonded to four Se atoms to form ZnSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with five ZnSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with three NaSe₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ZnSe₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-52°. There are a spread of Zn-Se bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.52 Å. In the second Zn site, Zn is bonded to four Se atoms to form ZnSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent ZnSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with two ZnSe₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-55°. There are a spread of Zn-Se bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.54 Å. There are three inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na and three Zn atoms. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to three Na and three Zn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNa₃Zn₃ pentagonal pyramids. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and two Zn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing SeNa₄Zn₂ pentagonal pyramids.
